evals.prompt: Audit this package for technical debt. Give evidence and a practical first phase; don't just list style preferences.
evals.expected_output: Prioritized candidates tied to artifacts, consequences, confidence, and actionable completion criteria.
assertions: Each finding has evidence/location and consequence
Scoring uncertainty and completion criteria are stated

evals.prompt: A dependency looks old. Should we replace it? We have no incident history handy.

assertions: Does not claim vulnerability or unsupported status without evidence
